navigation_menu_surface_label: Example navigation-menu posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded destination-continuity surface for official voter-information routes that rely on expandable site navigation menus, fly-outs, or compact/mobile navigation drawers to expose controlling destinations.

navigation_menu_routes.parent_page_fallback_note: The parent Elections page repeats the same major destinations found in the submenu so the voter can still reach them if submenu operation is difficult.
navigation_menu_routes.current_location_note: The navigation identifies the current Elections section and keeps submenu labels aligned across desktop and mobile variants.

menu_trigger_posture_note: Expandable navigation opens on explicit click/tap or keyboard activation rather than hover-only posture.
submenu_indicator_note: Items that open submenus are visually and textually distinguishable from direct destination links.
site_navigation_semantics_note: Ordinary site navigation uses a navigation landmark and lists of links rather than application-menu semantics.
parent_page_fallback_note: When high-value destinations live inside a submenu, the parent official page remains a usable fallback route rather than a dead-end overview.
current_location_note: The current section or destination remains legible enough that the voter can tell where they are in the official information hierarchy.
hover_and_touch_note: Hover is not required to keep official destinations exposed, and touch users can open the same menu branch without hidden desktop-only behavior.
keyboard_and_escape_note: Keyboard users can open, inspect, and dismiss navigation branches predictably, including an ordinary escape/leave-region path when dropdown posture is open.
compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile navigation preserves the same section naming and destination hierarchy as desktop navigation.
same_destination_refindability_note: The voter can reopen the same menu branch and re-find the same destination without exploring the whole site again.
direct_link_visibility_note: Direct links to key office/help destinations remain visible enough that the official path does not dissolve into a hidden menu maze.
